gaps_found: G1: fat16_read_dir returned 8.3-mangled names only; a payload listing never shows the real long names
G2: fat16_mkdir wrote no 0x0F records, so a long directory name was unreachable by its real name
G3: fat16_rename (same-dir and cross-dir) rewrote only the 8.3 name — the long name was silently dropped and old records orphaned
G4: fat16_unlink freed only same-sector preceding 0x0F records; a cross-sector run leaked slots
G5 (found by the new positive in-OS check during gating): fat16_read_dir reset its LFN accumulator per sector, so a run spanning a sector boundary (rename placement) was not listed with its long name
gaps_fixed: G1: read_dir now emits the reconstructed long name (checksum-valid 0x0F run) with the 8.3 fallback
G2: mkdir writes a 0x0F run for non-8.3 directory names (alloc_lfn_run)
G3: rename rewrites the whole run when old or new name is long (fresh slot + records, old slot+records freed); cross-dir move allocates LFN runs for long destination names
G4: new lfn_del_entry() helper frees the entry plus its 0x0F records incl. records spilling into the previous sector; used by unlink/rename
G5: read_dir LFN state now carries across sector (and cluster) boundaries, mirroring find_entry_in_root/subdir
gaps_deferred: read_dir syscall hard-caps listed names at 31 chars (frozen ABI, parent-owned syscall files): long names list truncated at 31; payload names <= 26 chars today, the 36-char fixture documents the cap

In-OS format_83 alias generation does not produce unique numeric suffixes; two long names with an identical 8.3 alias share the alias (distinct long-name resolution is implemented and tested; short-alias uniqueness is a v1 non-goal)
VFAT 255-char components unsupported (resolve_path component buffer 63); payload max component is 36 chars — no action
Total-path limits (clean_path ~127 chars / 16 components, VFS_PATH_MAX 256): the fixture's 85-char/7-component deep path works; L5's staging tool must keep payload paths within the caps
next_steps: Integrator: merge selfhost/l3-lfn-verify to main and re-run the gates on the merged tree
